body.purpose: System UI with Chinese-capable fallbacks for explanatory copy, controls, and table labels; 14px base size.

label.purpose: Dense statuses and secondary operational metadata; minimum 12px.

data.purpose: IDs, revisions, digests, sequence values, and timestamps; minimum 12px.

shadows.name: selected-control
shadows.purpose: Separate the active lane or view control from its quiet surface.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Quiet hover and selection feedback without shifting ledger rows.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Removes long transitions and repeating skeleton or spinner motion.

components.name: Primary Connection Button
components.description: The connection form action verifies a locally supplied bearer token; it does not create a release request or start a run.
components.css: .primary-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 39px; padding: 0 14px; color: #fff; background: #176b56; border: 1px solid #176b56; border-radius: 5px; font: 600 12px system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .primary-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #0f5b47; transform: translateY(-1px); } .primary-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #287e68; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Token Input
components.description: A raised token field with a separate labeled visibility control; the token stays in page memory.
components.css: .token-field { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 9px; color: #17221f; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #bdcac2; border-radius: 5px; } .token-field:focus-within { border-color: #559078; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(23, 107, 86, .12); } .token-field input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; height: 38px; color: #1f3026; background: transparent; border: 0; outline: 0; font: 12px 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace; } .connect-form label { color: #3c4d43; font: 600 12px system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; }

components.name: Lane Navigation Item
components.description: The selected lane uses a raised surface and a narrow leading green rule; lane labels and identifiers come from the API.
components.css: .lane-item { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; padding: 11px 10px 9px; color: #17221f; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .lane-item.is-current { background: #fff; border-color: #cbd9d0; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20, 42, 32, .035); } .lane-item.is-current::before { position: absolute; top: 8px; bottom: 8px; left: -1px; width: 2px; content: ''; background: #176b56; } .lane-project, .lane-environment { display: block; font: 12px system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .lane-id { display: block; font: 12px 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace; }

components.name: State Chip
components.description: A status dot is paired with its readable state label and pale state-tinted surface.
components.css: .status-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; min-height: 19px; padding: 2px 6px; color: #5a6861; background: #eef1ef; border: 1px solid #e0e5e1; border-radius: 4px; font: 400 12px system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .tone-active { color: #245e48; background: #e8f1ec; border-color: #d8e7dd; } .tone-active .status-dot { background: #33805a; }

components.name: Record Type Button Group
components.description: Requests and runs are distinct views selected with native buttons; the selected state is announced through aria-pressed. The event and log controls use the same pattern.
components.css: .view-switch { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; padding: 3px; background: #e7ebe8; border-radius: 6px; } .view-switch button { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 31px; padding: 0 9px; color: #5b6962; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; font: 400 12px system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .view-switch button.is-selected { color: #1c4937; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20, 42, 32, .09); }

components.name: Selected Ledger Row
components.description: Semantic request or run table cells keep status, revision, priority, relationship, and time aligned; selection adds a soft fill and leading rule.
components.css: .record-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; } .record-table th, .record-table td { font: 400 12px system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .record-table td { height: 66px; padding: 8px 9px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e8ece9; } .record-table tbody tr.is-active { background: #edf4f0; } .record-table tbody tr.is-active td:first-child { box-shadow: inset 2px 0 #176b56; }

components.name: Simulated Verification Receipt
components.description: A ScriptedExecutor receipt is explicitly labeled as simulated and exposes the source run, source revision, observation time, digests, and verification report.
components.html:
模拟验收回执模拟验收结果
验收来源 SHA{receipt.source_revision}
观察时间{receipt.observed_at}
验收报告 ScriptedExecutor 模拟证据
{receipt.verification_report}
components.css: .receipt-panel { margin: 9px 0 12px; padding: 10px; color: #3c654b; background: #f1f6f2; border: 1px solid #d9e7dc; border-radius: 5px; } .receipt-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #dce8de; font: 650 12px system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .receipt-result, .verification-report summary { font: 400 12px system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .receipt-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 11px 8px; padding: 10px 0 5px; } .receipt-grid .detail-field > span, .receipt-grid .detail-field > strong { font-size: 12px; } .verification-report pre { max-height: 220px; padding: 8px; overflow: auto; font: 12px/1.55 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

narrative.overview:
The Dispatch Ledger treats release coordination as a record-keeping job. Stable rows, aligned identifiers, narrow state labels, and a clear request-to-run link make it quick to scan what is waiting and inspect what actually happened. The interface is quiet and precise, with green reserved for connection, selection, and verified success; warm colors identify urgency or uncertainty.

The ledger is the primary working surface. Requests and executions remain separate records, while the inspector carries their relationship, phase history, receipt, and bounded logs. It uses only records returned by the service and keeps unresolved ownership explicit. Its compact operational density is a deliberate fit for developer and release-owner workflows.
keyCharacteristics: Request and execution identity remain distinct.
State color always appears with a readable label.
Borders, alignment, and surface tone carry most of the hierarchy.
Verification details remain traceable to their source execution.

rules.name: The Paired-State Rule
rules.body: A state color never carries meaning alone; retain the status word or an explanatory sentence beside it.

rules.name: The Data-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Keep monospace on machine identifiers and numeric evidence; use the interface sans for explanatory text.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Use borders and surface changes for structure; reserve shadows for compact selected controls.

dos: Keep the request and execution ledgers visibly distinct.
Show the request’s current run or the historical run that satisfied it.
Make unknown ownership and superseded execution status explicit in words.
Keep IDs, revisions, and receipt evidence easy to copy and inspect.
Respect reduced-motion preferences and visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't invent sample records, summary metrics, or activity in the live view.
Don't imply that a superseded run means its request failed.
Don't use state colors without text labels.
Don't make the page scroll horizontally on a phone.
Don't persist bearer tokens in browser storage.
